method: Static generation from exported layout/stats. Tests every accepted anchor against actual spherical terrain, existing planting clearance, independently intersected tangent building footprints, continuous great-circle trail segments, existing and new tree geodesic spacing. Geometry attributes are checked for finite aligned values. No browser, application build or frame-rate measurement.
limitations: Spacing concerns trunk anchors; canopies may overlap naturally.
Low plants and lookout furniture are decorative, without individual movement colliders.
This check does not establish visual quality, rendered shadow cost or device performance.
